controls.title: Access Control Implementation
controls.description: Verify authentication and authorization controls are implemented
controls.recommendation: Implement authentication middleware and role-based access control (RBAC)

controls.title: Security Documentation
controls.description: Verify security policies and procedures are documented
controls.recommendation: Create SECURITY.md documenting security policies, incident response, and vulnerability reporting

controls.title: Automated Security Scanning
controls.description: Verify automated vulnerability scanning is configured
controls.recommendation: Configure automated security scanning (Snyk, CodeQL, Trivy) and dependency updates (Dependabot)

controls.title: Strong Authentication
controls.description: Verify multi-factor authentication and secure password storage
controls.recommendation: Implement MFA/2FA and use bcrypt/argon2 for password hashing

controls.title: Audit Logging
controls.description: Verify comprehensive audit logging is implemented
controls.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with security events (auth, access, changes)

controls.title: CI/CD and Code Review
controls.description: Verify automated deployment pipeline and code review process
controls.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with required code reviews and branch protection

controls.title: Encryption at Rest
controls.description: Verify sensitive data is encrypted at rest
controls.recommendation: Implement AES-256 encryption for sensitive data storage using approved libraries

controls.title: TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
controls.description: Verify TLS 1.2+ is enforced for all transmissions
controls.recommendation: Enforce HTTPS with TLS 1.2+, enable HSTS, use secure cookies

controls.title: Input Validation
controls.description: Verify input validation and sanitization is implemented
controls.recommendation: Use validation libraries (Joi, Zod, validator.js) for all user input

controls.title: Session Management
controls.description: Verify session timeout and management controls
controls.recommendation: Implement 15-minute session timeout, secure session tokens, and session invalidation on logout

controls.title: Security Event Logging
controls.description: Verify security events are logged with sufficient detail
controls.recommendation: Log all authentication events, access to cardholder data, and administrative actions

controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment
controls.description: Verify regular security testing is performed
controls.recommendation: Configure SAST/DAST scanning and schedule quarterly penetration tests

controls.title: Unique User Identification
controls.description: Verify unique user identification for accessing PHI
controls.recommendation: Implement unique user accounts with individual credentials for all PHI access

controls.title: PHI Access Audit Trail
controls.description: Verify audit trails for PHI access are maintained
controls.recommendation: Implement comprehensive audit logging for all PHI access with who/what/when/where

controls.title: Data Integrity Controls
controls.description: Verify mechanisms to protect PHI from improper alteration
controls.recommendation: Implement checksums, digital signatures, or hashing for PHI integrity verification

controls.title: Person Authentication
controls.description: Verify mechanisms to authenticate person or entity accessing PHI
controls.recommendation: Implement multi-factor authentication for all PHI access

controls.title: PHI Transmission Encryption
controls.description: Verify PHI is encrypted during transmission
controls.recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ for all PHI transmissions, implement end-to-end encryption

controls.title: Data Minimization
controls.description: Verify data collection is limited to necessary purposes
controls.recommendation: Implement data minimization, purpose limitation, and privacy-by-default configurations

controls.title: Pseudonymization and Encryption
controls.description: Verify appropriate security measures for personal data
controls.recommendation: Implement encryption and pseudonymization for personal data processing

controls.title: Incident Response Procedure
controls.description: Verify breach notification procedures are documented
controls.recommendation: Document incident response procedures with 72-hour notification capability

controls.title: Right to Erasure
controls.description: Verify data deletion capability is implemented
controls.recommendation: Implement complete user data deletion including all backups and third-party systems

controls.title: Data Portability
controls.description: Verify data export capability is implemented
controls.recommendation: Implement data export in machine-readable format (JSON, CSV)
